hyperedges.label: Sidebar UI Composition Stack
hyperedges.note: SidebarProvider orchestrates the full sidebar layout, internally composing Sheet for mobile, Skeleton for loading states, Input for search, and Separator for visual dividers.

hyperedges.label: Form Field System
hyperedges.note: The form components collectively implement a react-hook-form-integrated field system with context-driven ID/error propagation via useFormField.

hyperedges.label: Command Palette Dialog Pattern
hyperedges.note: CommandDialog composes the Dialog shell with the Command primitive to create an accessible command palette overlay.
